push.title: W 4-2 vs Hegseth FC | You: 9.2
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 9.2. If confidence were contagious, you just gave the whole team a cold.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at Hegseth FC's goal. Fortune favors the folks who shoot.
+ Feeding BellyTb1 like that is a recipe I want to keep making.
+ 10th straight match at 7.5 match rating. Keep that in your back pocket.
+ Giveaways 5, down from your usual 11. Pure hustle, and hustle is free.
+ Missed tackles 1, down from your usual 3. Write that one down and stick it on the fridge.

THE BAD
- Tackles attempted 1, down from your usual 4. That's the bit that kept us from winning.
- On-ball actions 35, down from your usual 43. That needs to look different next time out.
- Shots on target: 75%. Respectable. Top-quarter forwards get to 90%+, and you've got it in you.
- Key passes: 1. You're in the neighborhood. The fancy houses start at 2+.

Work on: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.

PhogsToffees, something I want you to sleep on: Don't be afraid of the dark. That's when the stars come out.

That's how it's done. More of that, please. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-2 vs Hegseth FC | You: 9.2
push.body:
Hoo-wee, BellyTb1. A 9.2. You played like someone who ate their vegetables.

THE GOOD
+ 2 of 2 shots on target. That's composure in front of goal.
+ 2 assists. You're the reason the forwards have something to celebrate.
+ That partnership with PhogsToffees is starting to feel like a habit.
+ Most completed passes you've had in 114 matches for us (30). You can build a whole match on that.
+ 8th straight match at 7.5 match rating. Keep stacking those bricks.

THE BAD
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 3. Let's sharpen this: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.
- Shots 2, down from your usual 4. That's the gap between a good night and a great one.
- Worst key passes of your 4 matches this session (0). Let's not make that a pattern.
- Their humans averaged 34 completed passes; you had 30. That's a habit trying to sneak in. Don't let it.

Fundamentals drill: Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.

Before you go, BellyTb1: Pressure is a privilege. It means you're playing for something.

Keep being you. - Coach Lasso
